answer: Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Reaching the kernel of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The design leans on gossip protocol threshold filtering that isolates unvouched swarm nodes. Written in a pragmatic engineering phrasing, concise declarative statements register, it stays short. The sonnet holds work receipts rather than names, so the beacon of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread.
